0.original: Everything Uin Nee does, they do for the children.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Search for relics near the House of the First Light.

25.original: Deliver the drowned relic to Uin Nee.

48.original: Answer me this, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>: when you were a child, what was your favorite dream you ever dreamed? Wait, you <hex:021A020203>were<hex:021A020103> a dreaming child once, yes? That's how it works, is it not?

49.original: Anyhow, let me guess: you loved to dream of going on grand adventures. Journeying to the bottom of the deepest waters! Braving perilous ruins in search of ancient treasures! Why, that's what <hex:021A020203>I'd<hex:021A020103> like to dream of if I were a mortal child!

50.original: Yes, I do believe that settles it: something precious from the ruins of the House of the First Light should be just what I need to spin the most stirring and dramatic dream ever! And <hex:021A020203>you're<hex:021A020103> going to bring it to me─for the children, of course!

51.original: What sort of relic will make the children happy? Well, how should I know? Only one of us has been a mortal child once, and it certainly isn't me! Anyhow, I'll leave it up to you. If I don't like what you bring me, I'll just send you back for more! Tee hee!

52.original: Ooh! You're back! Wait...back from where, again? Oh, that's right! Tell me: what wondrous relic did you find for me under the waters?

53.original: Why, it's a teensy-weensy figure of a knight. How very interesting!

54.original: They say that in the old days of Voeburt, people used to play a game where they moved these bitsy people around a board. It doesn't sound nearly as fun as spinning dreams, but to each their own, I suppose.

55.original: A silver ring...? It's so strangely cold to the touch. And these engravings...

56.original: Ack! These runes are to ward away pixies! Whatever is the meaning of this, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? Could it be that─gasp!─you don't like me as much as I like you?

57.original: Why, it's an old Voeburtite coin! They say that back in the days of the Kingdom, you could buy all sorts of things with these. I haven't seen one of these in years...

58.original: Anyhow, I simply must polish it up to the finest sheen! Only the very best for my dreamers!

59.original: In any event, I do believe this will make for a most rousing treasure hunt for the children. If only you could be a child again, yes? I'd like nothing more than to spin you a dream as a token of my thanks!
